detailed_descriptions.en: Craft the perfect burger with tons of ingredients. Create your own recipes to wow your customers! Make them big or small, vegan or fishy. Add an egg, try black bread, or even go bun-less! Play solo or team up in 2-8 player co-op! Grab your friends and family to whip up fast food together. Work as a team to boost your speed and quality. Assign roles and conquer the kitchen! Serve a cast of quirky customers, from aliens to cats! Learn their unique tastes and serve their favorite meals as fast as you can. Discover new ingredients for your burgers, drinks, and other fast food. Explore the galaxy and meet all sorts of unique customers at your shop. It's not just about burgers! Serve up a variety of drinks like juices, sodas, and iced coffee. Don't forget the sides: fry up some french fries, calamari, and onion rings. ✨ P.S. We're huge fans of games like "Good Pizza, Great Pizza," the "Papa's" series, "Overcooked," and "Plate Up!" We're a small team of enthusiasts who love space and tasty food. We hope you do, too!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Craft the perfect burger with tons of ingredients. Create your own recipes to wow your customers! Make them big or small, vegan or fishy. Add an egg, try black bread, or even go bun-less!




Play solo or team up in 2-8 player co-op! Grab your friends and family to whip up fast food together. Work as a team to boost your speed and quality. Assign roles and conquer the kitchen!




Serve a cast of quirky customers, from aliens to cats! Learn their unique tastes and serve their favorite meals as fast as you can.




Discover new ingredients for your burgers, drinks, and other fast food. Explore the galaxy and meet all sorts of unique customers at your shop.




It's not just about burgers! Serve up a variety of drinks like juices, sodas, and iced coffee. Don't forget the sides: fry up some french fries, calamari, and onion rings.

✨ P.S.

We're huge fans of games like "Good Pizza, Great Pizza," the "Papa's" series, "Overcooked," and "Plate Up!" We're a small team of enthusiasts who love space and tasty food. We hope you do, too!
